name: qkd_pv_ctl_rstpin_a72-a72-COMMIT
purpose: Q-KVSYS PVCTL72 10-16: same r5 tile (outline 43.2x43.2, M5, RTL pin flops, rst_n pin capture) at FIRST_INPUT_AGE 72 for KV die trial kvs13d: closed V port qkd_pv16_vport_r6 (DQ 0 / RT 8) with every die relay edge equalised to W 59 -> RL = 4+59+0+8 = 71, pair FIRST_INPUT_AGE = RL+1 = 72. Parameter-only change of the calendar constant; 0 cycles added in the tile.

bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qwen_tp8_pv_wide_ctl #(.FIRST_INPUT_AGE(72), .RESET_PIN(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_tp8_pv_wide_pair.sv && echo lint-ok
